name: Ride to Ironforge
summary: Brock Stoneseeker sends you from Thelsamar to Ironforge with the names of his finest mining students. You carry his list to Golnir Bouldertoe at the Great Forge.

sections.title: Taking to the Skies
sections.body: Thorgrum Borrelson carries you from Thelsamar over Dun Morogh's snowy ridges to the mountain fortress. For many young mountaineers and travelers, this is their first flight on a gryphon.

sections.title: Honors of the Deep Mountain Guild
sections.body: At the Great Forge, Golnir Bouldertoe carves the students' names into ceremonial honorary picks. These honors recognize their hard work in Loch Modan's quarries and mines.

faq.q: Where does this flight start and end?
faq.answer: Thorgrum Borrelson carries you from Thelsamar in Loch Modan to the flight roost by Ironforge's Great Forge.
Brock Stoneseeker's list names his finest mining students in Thelsamar, so the guild in Ironforge can honor their diligence.
Golnir Bouldertoe represents the Deep Mountain Mining Guild at Ironforge's Great Forge. He receives rosters from local trainers and carves the students' names into honorary picks.

faq.q: What happens after you deliver the list?
faq.answer: Once Golnir receives the roster, he sends you to Gryth Thurden, Ironforge's master gryphon handler, to learn about the kingdom's aerial routes.

faq.q: Why use a gryphon instead of walking?
faq.answer: The mountain road and tunnels reach Ironforge's Gates, but flying by gryphon shows how quickly Alliance travelers can move between settlements.
An honorary pick is a ceremonial tool the Deep Mountain Mining Guild gives to outstanding students of mining. Regional instructors teach them the basics of excavation and geology.

angles.text: As a miner, you see how the Deep Mountain Mining Guild honors promising miners from Loch Modan's pits by carving their names into picks.
As a young Bronzebeard dwarf, your gryphon flight into the Great Forge marks a proud passage from rural outposts to the heart of the kingdom.
As an Alliance traveler, you can rely on gryphon routes to link Khaz Modan's frontline garrisons with its capital.
